title: corydalis bulbosa f. intermedia
intro: Corydalis bulbosa f. intermedia, commonly known as Yellow Corydalis or Yan Hu Suo, is a plant species within the Corydalis genus, characterized by its yellow flowers and tuberous roots. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including pain, inflammation, and anxiety, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Corydalis bulbosa f. intermedia include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and sedative effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as tetrahydroprotoberberine alkaloids and phenanthrene alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of this plant, particularly berberine, are responsible for its therapeutic properties, making it a valuable herbal medicine in traditional and modern treatments.
